name: bb-plugin-voice-reactions
description: BB plugin: a short spoken reaction to what you write to your agents.
author: Sergey Petrov

scripts.bundle: bun x --package bb-app@0.49.0 bb plugin build . && bun -e "const f = 'dist/server.js.map'; await Bun.write(f, (await Bun.file(f).text()).replaceAll(process.cwd() + '/', '../../'))"
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && tsc --noEmit && bun run check:knip

bb.name: Voice reactions
bb.description: Speaks a short in-character reaction to the messages you send your agents: a model picks the reaction, a voice model says it.
